claims: The Kraken is a legendary Scandinavian sea monster.
The Kraken is often described as a massive, ship-destroying cephalopod (octopus or squid).
The Kraken originates from Nordic folklore.
The Kraken was historically depicted as a colossal creature sometimes resembling a crab or whale.
The legend of the Kraken stems from Scandinavian folklore.
The Kraken has early descriptions from the 18th century.
Erik Pontoppidan described the Kraken as a creature that could create dangerous whirlpools.
The word Kraken comes from Norwegian/German.
The word Kraken stems from "krake".
"Krake" refers to an unhealthy animal or twisted tree.
The Kraken was historically described as "many-headed and clawed".
The Kraken was historically described as a giant polypus (octopus).
The Kraken was often mistaken for land or islands.
The Kraken is depicted in Pirates of the Caribbean.
Giant squids such as Architeuthis dux are widely considered to be the real-life basis for the Kraken myth.
The Kraken cryptocurrency exchange was founded in 2011.
The Kraken cryptocurrency exchange is a U.S.-based exchange for trading Bitcoin and other digital assets.
The Kraken cryptocurrency exchange was the first crypto platform to pass a Proof of Reserves audit.
The Seattle Kraken is a professional hockey team in the NHL.
"Kraken" refers to a distributed P2P Docker registry for file distribution.
